text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Finally, someone to achieve the Tenno
Sweep has
appeared.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A Mejiro who has secured two glorious
victories in
the same year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: McQueen! I did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I won two plaques for the Mejiros... In
the past, I
was nothing but a burden, but
now look at what
I've managed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This is quite the accomplishment, Bright.

However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You deserve praise from someone more
than
myself. What you've accomplished
has surpassed
my own achievements.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What?! Eighteenth?! But I came in first!

text_block_list.name: Racing Steward
text_block_list.text:
Course obstruction. You prevented other

Umamusume from advancing.

text_block_list.name: Racing Steward
text_block_list.text:
At the turn right after the start, do you
recall how
deeply you cut in toward the
inside?

text_block_list.name: Racing Steward
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain obstruction was not your
intention,
but our decision stands.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gasp?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But I need to win the 2,000-meter race
at Tokyo.
No... I can't lose...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That was my first autumn Tenno Sho. I
was so
eager to prove that I could win, I
lost control of
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This goes to show you are more skilled
than I.
Where I failed, you succeeded.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: More... skilled...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No, McQueen. I'm afraid you're
mistaken.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's just a matter of who ran this race
first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Who ran first?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly. I watched your race with
my own
eyes, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I inherited that experience and your
frustration,
as well as your precious
desire to bring glory to
the family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That's why this Tenno Sweep is not my
victory
alone, but an accomplishment for
all Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This is something we accomplished
together, us Mejiros from each
generation. That means you
and I as
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Bright... You...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I see. That's certainly one way of
looking at
it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Your spectacular way of observing things
has
encouraged me. That's another one
of your skills.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Bright. Thank you for

brightening that dark moment of my
past.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright may just be one
Umamusume, but she's also an inheritor
of history. And she made use of that
history to accomplish something 
incredible today.
